rows.grounds: sandhi fusion of tasya and ūrdhva-tala-vistāram; compound denoting the extent of the upper surface
compound with past participle vibhājita; indicates division according to Rudra shares

items.question: How is the upper surface spread determined by division into Rudra parts?
premises: The structure has an upper surface spread to be measured.
This spread is subject to division into Rudra parts.
The prescribed partition follows Rudra-based shares.
items.inference: The upper surface spread is determined by dividing it into Rudra parts.
uncertainties: The exact numerical value or count implied by Rudra parts is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: The spread of its upper surface should be determined by dividing it into Rudra parts.
